IFNULL(purchase_orders.discount_amount,0) + IFNULL(purchase_orders.total_vat,0)) AS totalAmount, purchase_orders.balance AS balance, purchase_orders.status AS status, purchase_orders.po_type AS poType, purchase_orders.is_approve AS isApproved, purchase_orders.approved AS approved, CONCAT(users3.first_name, ' ', users3.last_name) AS approvedBy, purchase_orders.created AS created, CONCAT(users1.first_name, ' ', users1.last_name) AS createdBy, purchase_orders.modified AS modified, CONCAT(users2.first_name, ' ', users2.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM purchase_orders LEFT JOIN purchase_requests ON purchase_orders.purchase_request_id = purchase_requests.id LEFT JOIN pv_requests ON purchase_orders.pv_request_id = pv_requests.id LEFT JOIN companies ON purchase_orders.company_id = companies.id LEFT JOIN vendors ON purchase_orders.vendor_id = vendors.id LEFT JOIN locations ON purchase_orders.location_id = locations.id LEFT JOIN location_groups ON purchase_orders.location_group_id = location_groups.id LEFT JOIN chart_accounts ON purchase_orders.ap_id = chart_accounts.id LEFT JOIN payment_terms ON purchase_orders.payment_term_id = payment_terms.id LEFT JOIN payment_types ON payment_terms.payment_type_id = payment_types.id LEFT JOIN shipments ON purchase_orders.shipment_id = shipments.id LEFT JOIN vat_settings ON purchase_orders.vat_setting_id = vat_settings.id LEFT JOIN users AS users1 ON users1.id = purchase_orders.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS users2 ON users2.id = purchase_orders.modified_by LEFT JOIN users AS users3 ON users3.id = purchase_orders.approved_by

( SELECT 1 AS `type`, purchase_order_details.id AS id, purchase_order_details.product_id AS itemId, products.name AS itemName, IFNULL(products.small_val_uom, 1) / IFNULL(purchase_order_details.conversion, 1) AS conversion, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, products.is_expired_date AS isExpiredDate, purchase_order_details.date_expired AS expiredDate, purchase_order_details.qty_free AS foc, purchase_order_details.qty AS qty, purchase_order_details.qty_uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, purchase_order_details.unit_cost AS unitCost, purchase_order_details.total_cost AS totalCost, purchase_order_details.note AS note, purchase_order_details.discount_amount AS discountAmount, purchase_order_details.discount_percent AS discountPercent FROM purchase_order_details INNER JOIN products ON products.id = purchase_order_details.product_id INNER JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = purchase_order_details.qty_uom_id WHERE purchase_order_details.purchase_order_id = #{id} ) UNION ( SELECT 2 AS `type`, purchase_order_services.id AS id, purchase_order_services.service_id AS itemId, services.name AS itemName, 1 AS conversion, NULL AS sku, NULL AS upc, NULL AS isExpiredDate, NULL AS expiredDate, purchase_order_services.qty_free AS foc, purchase_order_services.qty AS qty, NULL AS uomId, NULL AS uomName, purchase_order_services.unit_cost AS unitCost, purchase_order_services.total_cost AS totalCost, purchase_order_services.note AS note, purchase_order_services.discount_amount AS discountAmount, purchase_order_services.discount_percent AS discountPercent FROM purchase_order_services LEFT JOIN services ON services.id = purchase_order_services.service_id WHERE purchase_order_services.purchase_order_id = #{id} ) ORDER BY `type` DESC, id ASC
